WelfareFundLegalAlert:
Takes effect 1 Oct 2026 under the Labour Protection Act, Chapter 13, Sections 130-134 — confirmed from the statutory text: applies only to employers with 10+ employees (unless already covered by a provident fund or equivalent statutory welfare — Section 130); the statutory contribution rate must not exceed 5% of wages (Section 131), and the law sets no wage cap for the calculation (the default 0.25%/0.5% rates come from the subsequent ministerial regulation, cross-checked against multiple sources) — details not yet confirmed: the end date of the first rate period (30 Sep 2030 or 2031 — sources conflict slightly) and the exact remittance channel/frequency to the Department of Labour Protection and Welfare.
This calculation is already wired into real payroll processing, but only takes effect for rate ranges that are enabled (IsEnabled) — every seeded range is disabled by default.
